messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-queue-provision" severity=HIGH. Condition=queue_length > 10k (us-east-1). autoscaler_slo_breach. Pager: @oncall (Maya).

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #PD-8921 created. Escalation policy=oncall-sre. Mode=page.

Maya: acked. I'm on it, grabbing logs and topology. What region exactly?

incident-bot: Alert details: region=us-east-1, affected_cell=cell-7, queue_backlog=12,400, avg-latency=4200ms (90th), error_rate=3.1% (502s). Autoscaler target_replicas=48, current_replicas=18, last_scale_event=~22m ago.

Leo: thanks. Initial hypothesis: node pool hit instance quota and cluster autoscaler didn't get any nodes. Check k8s events and cloud provider quota. @Hana can you confirm if cell-7 had node provisioning failures?

Hana: looking. I see repeated FailedCreatePod events referencing volume provisioning errors and then cloud API 403 on node create: 

```
E0603 15:12:04  cron  FailedCreate: pod "inference-..." is forbidden: quota exceeded for instances "n1-standard-16" in project
cloud-api: POST /compute/v1/projects/redwood/zones/us-east1-b/instances -> 403 QuotaExceeded
```

Hana: also kube-autoscaler logs show: 
```
I0603 15:10:34 scale.go:124 attempted to increase nodes by 10, provider returned error: quotaExceeded
```

Tom: cloud quotas are indeed at limit for that project account. We had a background capacity migration earlier this week that consumed extra reserved instances in us-east. I can request quota bump but that's not instantaneous.

Maya: immediate mitigation ideas? Any cheap quick wins to relieve backlog while we request quota?

Leo: options: 1) temporarily scale down low-priority models/routes (batch jobs, non-customer models) to free GPU slots; 2) enable burst evict policy to move some dev traffic to other regions; 3) enable soft-fallback to smaller quantized model variants. Which can we flip fast?

Hana: we can flip soft-fallback per-route via routing rules in ~2-5min. Downgrading models reduces per-request resource by ~40%. Creating policy: set route-match "non-critical*" -> model_variant=rev_quant_v2 for the cell.

Tom: I can also spin a few temporarily on shared-host pool in us-east-2 if latency delta ok. Network egress fee and cross-region latency ~200ms extra. Need ops approval.

Eve: support reports a spike in customer tickets about timeouts in the NYC region; impact map shows ~6% of all requests seeing 5s+ timeouts, mostly on chat endpoints. We should prep a customer message if mitigation will be longer than 30m.

Maya: action plan: 
- Hana: implement per-route soft-fallback rule for non-critical models (2-5m).
- Leo: identify and pause any batch/maintenance jobs using GPU (1-3m).
- Tom: request emergency quota bump with cloud support and provision temporary cross-region spill to us-east-2 (if approved).
- Eve: draft a short status update for customers (I'll review).

Hana: doing the soft-fallback now. Pushing config: 
```
PATCH /routing/v1/configs/cell-7
rules:
  - match: "/models/noncritical/*"
    action: route_to_variant
    variant: "rev_quant_v2"
    ttl: 00:30:00
```
Applied at 15:17:20.

Maya: Leo, Tom, check current queue after change.

Leo: queue dropped from 12,400 -> 7,900 in ~4m. 90th latency down from 4200ms -> 2800ms. Error rate -> 1.8%. Promising.

Tom: cloud support replied: emergency quota request submitted, estimate 1-2h. Meanwhile I started provisioning 6 preemptible instances in us-east-2 and added them as a temporary shared pool. Deployed nodes at 15:22:40. Routed low-priority batch to us-east-2.

incident-bot: Automated action: routing_rule_applied by Hana at 15:17:20. Metric note: queue_length decreased 36% in 6m post-change.

Maya: good. Leo, audit any pods stuck in Pending due to PV/VPC.

Leo: found 18 pods Pending due to PVC binding stuck on cell-7. Rescheduled some with ephemeral volumes to get them running on new nodes. Issued command: 
```
kubectl patch pod <pod> -p '{"spec":{"volumes":[]}}' --namespace=inference
```
Now pending count down to 4.

Eve: draft status for customers: 
"We are currently experiencing higher request latency and intermittent timeouts in US-East affecting chat endpoints. We have applied targeted mitigations to reduce impact while we scale capacity. Engineers are actively working on the underlying quota and provisioning issue. We will provide updates every 30 minutes."

Maya: LGTM. Post that to status page and #customers-updates.

Tom: provisioning to us-east-2 reduced pressure; however, some traffic stays regional for data locality. Recommend schedule a follow-up runbook change: allow cross-region spill for low-priority routes.

Hana: soft-fallback TTL expired at 15:47, but we kept it renewed until cluster is healthy. Re-applied another 30m at 15:45.

Leo: monitoring: queue now at 2,100, 90th latency 900ms, error rate 0.4%. Not back to baseline but much better.

pagerduty-bot: Incident auto-close candidate: metrics recovered to threshold for 20m. Mark for manual review before close.

Maya: leaving open until cloud quota resolved. Tom, any ETA?

Tom: cloud support just updated: temporary quota expansion approved to add 24 instances in us-east-1, ETA 18-25 minutes. They are pushing nodes now.

Hana: once new nodes join I'll trigger autoscaler reconcile and we should see target_replicas climb to ~55 and backlog clear.

Leo: prepping postmortem notes: root cause = exhausted cloud instance quota post-migration + autoscaler lacked graceful degraded path for node create failures (no cross-region spill automatic fallback). Mitigations=immediate soft-fallback routing, manual cross-region spill, ephemeral-volume rescheduling, emergency quota request. Follow-ups: update autoscaler policy to detect provider quota errors and automatically enable spill, add runbook step for quota monitoring alerts.

Maya: agreed. I'll own postmortem and customer comms. Will schedule 1hr retrospective with infra/runtime.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident #PD-8921: state=acknowledged by Maya at 15:18:05.

Tom: new nodes joining: first node registered at 15:40:12, additional nodes 15:42:07, 15:44:11. Autoscaler reconcile done at 15:45:30. Target replicas is now 54.

Leo: backlog draining fast. queue length 420 -> 60 by 15:51. Latency back to normal 160ms.

Maya: calling this mitigated. Keeping incident open for follow-ups. Good work everyone. :thumbsup:

Eve: posted status update to customers and support channel. No major escalations from top customers so far.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-8921 has been marked resolved candidate. Leaving open pending follow-up ticket creation.

Maya: create follow-up ticket with action items and link to this thread. I'll add draft for postmortem.

Leo: created ticket INF-3789 with tasks: autop-enable spill on quota error, add quota guardrails, update runbook.

Maya: thanks. Closing log: incident start=15:12, mitigations applied 15:17-15:22, capacity restored 15:45-15:51. Total customer impact window ~39m.

incident-bot: Thread closed by Maya at 15:52:00 (kept for postmortem notes).
